subject: [RFC PATCH v3 12/14] mm/memcontrol: Kick async reclaim on migration and folio replacement

2026-08-07.patch_summary: This patch introduces a mechanism to kick asynchronous reclaimers when memory is being migrated or replaced, specifically in cases where soft limits are set and the system has tiered memcg limits enabled. The goal is to prevent forced charges from exceeding high memcg tier limits by triggering async reclaim. The patch adds two new functions: `tier_kick_high` which schedules a work item if the current usage exceeds the high limit, and modifies existing code in `mem_cgroup_replace_folio` and `mem_cgroup_migrate` to call this function when necessary. This approach aims to balance memory usage with soft limits without relying on synchronous reclaim.
